jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Branch

Branch is a leading AI-powered lending fintech with 50M+ downloads across India and Africa. We use alternative data and machine learning to expand financial access for millions of people traditionally excluded from the formal financial system. Founded by the former CEO of Kiva.org and backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, and the IFC, Branch combines mission-driven impact with world-class technology and scale.

In India, Branch operates as a regulated digital lending institution and Middle Layer NBFC, building trusted and accessible financial products for millions of customers across the country. Our 250+ member India team is growing rapidly and works across technology, data science, risk, product, and operations to solve high-impact problems at scale.

Certified as a Great Place to Work in 2025, Branch offers the opportunity to build meaningful careers while shaping the future of inclusive fintech in one of the world’s fastest-growing digital economies.

About the role

Branch launched its lending business in India in 2019 and has seen rapid adoption and growth. We are growing our product and engineering team in India. As part of the product team, you will work closely with our global engineering team (distributed across three continents) to strengthen the capabilities of our existing product and build out new products for Branch.

As a company, we are passionate about our customers, fearless in the face of barriers, and driven by data. As a product-driven org, we value bottom-up innovation and decentralized decision-making. We believe the best ideas can come from anyone in the company, and we create an environment where everyone feels empowered to propose solutions to the challenges we face. As a Product Manager, you will help the team achieve its goals through deep product work and servant-style leadership.

Responsibilities

  • Obsess over the customer. Understand customer problems through data analysis, user research, and direct customer feedback.
  • Turn ambiguity into clarity. Break complex business problems into clear product opportunities and actionable roadmaps.
  • Build products people love. Define product requirements and partner closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Experiment relentlessly. Design experiments, analyze results, and use evidence—not opinions—to make product decisions.
  • Own outcomes, not outputs. Track product performance through metrics, identify opportunities, and continuously improve customer and business outcomes.
  • Win as one team. Collaborate with Risk, Operations, Data Science, Compliance, Design, and Engineering to solve customer problems together.
  • Expand what’s possible. Evaluate and manage third-party partnerships and integrations that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Shape the future. Contribute to product strategy by identifying opportunities that create long-term value for our customers and the business.

What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you’ll likely have:

  • Shipped multiple customer-facing product improvements.
  • Independently owned one or more product initiatives.
  • Designed and analyzed experiments that influenced roadmap decisions.
  • Improved key business metrics such as conversion, activation, repayment, retention, or operational efficiency.
  • Become a trusted partner to Engineering, Design, Risk, and Operations teams.

About you

  • You thrive in ambiguity. Demonstrated the ability to manage projects, bring clarity to ambiguous questions, and chart a path forward.
  • You think in numbers. Top-notch analytical abilities. You can measure initiatives quantitatively, and you draw actionable insights to guide decisions.
  • You elevate the team. You know that startups are a team sport. You listen to others, speak your mind, and ask the right questions. You are a great collaborator and teacher. Effective written communication skills and the ability to work with remote teams are essential.
  • You never stop learning. You are eager to learn new skills, solve complex problems, and work closely with diverse teams, including Design and Engineering.
  • You have a bias for action. You are resourceful. You know how to do more with less, and you’ve worked on lean teams that have had a large impact. You are not afraid of big challenges, and you do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Additional Criteria

  • 1 to 3 years of total experience
  • Experience with Fintech industry would be good, but not a must-have

Benefits of Joining

  • Competitive salary and equity package
  • Fast-paced, collaborative, and high-autonomy work culture
  • Hybrid work setup designed for flexibility and work-life balance
  • Fully paid group medical insurance and personal accident insurance
  • Generous paid time off, plus company-declared public holidays
  • Fully paid parental leave for fathers and non-birthing parents (12 weeks), in addition to 26 weeks of statutory maternity leave
  • Monthly WFH stipend, along with a one-time home office setup budget
  • $500 annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly social meet-ups and sponsored monthly team lunches

We’re looking for more than just qualifications –  if you’re unsure that you meet the criteria but identify with our vision of providing equal opportunity to everyone to access financial services, please do not hesitate to apply!

Branch International is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The company does not and will not discriminate in employment on any basis prohibited by applicable law.

jobs.title: Project Manager II
jobs.jd_full:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world’s most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we’re driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We’re committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

As a Project Manager within our global Customer Success team, you are the engine behind efficient onboarding and long-term scalability. You will lead Professional Services engagements and oversee enterprise customer onboardings, specifically those involving intricate use cases or large-scale migrations.

What you’ll do:

Project Execution & Delivery

  • Lead Professional Services (PS) Engagements: Drive rapid platform adoption by delivering projects against a defined Statements of Work (SOW).
  • End-to-End Project Management: Own timelines, communications, and change management from kickoff through User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and project closure.
  • Navigate Ambiguity: Proactively identify and unblock technical blockers for customers and engineers.
  • Reporting & Risk Mitigation: Compile tailored progress reports to communicate key insights and risks to both internal and external stakeholders.

Customer Strategy & Success

  • Customer Onboarding: Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) to lead proactive, prescriptive onboarding for Enterprise-level customers.
  • Growth & Expansion: Work closely with customers as they scale, ensuring they successfully migrate and expand their use cases on the platform.
  • Health & Success Planning: Collaborate with CSMs to audit account health and develop actionable, measurable success plans.
  • Stakeholder Management: Diplomatically navigate conflicting priorities to align diverse stakeholders toward a common goal.

Internal Impact & Innovation

  • Shape the Function: Provide critical input to help refine the team’s organizational structure, processes, and performance metrics.
  • Special Initiatives: Drive high-impact internal projects, including product feature betas, data initiatives, and large-scale migrations.

What you bring to the team:

Professional Experience

  • Project Management Expertise: 5+ years of experience leading complex, multi-tiered projects involving both internal and external stakeholders. PMP, CAPM, CSM, or any other project management certification preferred.
  • Technical Customer Success: A proven track record of supporting customers through technical implementations, complex migrations, or software onboarding.
  • Industry Context: Experience within the Cybersecurity, IT, or Business Operations sectors is highly preferred.

Execution & Tooling

  • PM Tech Stack: Proficiency in Smartsheet (or similar platforms like Monday.com or Asana), with experience using Salesforce and data tools like Looker or Omni to track progress.
  • AI-Augmented Delivery: Proficiency in utilizing AI tools to streamline project creation, enhance communication clarity, and accelerate overall delivery quality. The ideal candidate views and utilizes AI as a tool for acceleration and working smarter.
  • Delivery Frameworks: Familiar with User Acceptance Testing (UAT), change management, and project risk mitigation.
  • Commitment to Quality: A high standard of excellence in project delivery and a focus on producing sound, reliable outcomes.

Communication & Strategy

  • Strong Communication: A master of “the medium and the message”—you proactively tailor the frequency, tone, and content of communications to suit different audiences.
  • Detailed Architect: A unique ability to dive into the granular technical details while ensuring every task aligns with the broader business strategy and impact.
  • Cross-Functional Connector: A natural ability to “connect the dots” across teams and initiatives, ensuring alignment between CS, Sales, Product, and Engineering.

This role is remote with EMEA working hours.

#LI-SW1 #LI-remote

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Corporate Actions
jobs.jd_full:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24⁄5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We’re deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We’re a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We’re searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca’s rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

Own the corporate actions product lifecycle at a rapidly scaling self-clearing broker-dealer.

Your mission is to build and operate the systems, vendor relationships, and processes that keep Alpaca accurate, compliant, and on time across every corporate action, from announcement ingestion and entitlement calculation through processing, reconciliation, and client credit. You will ensure that corporate action operations scale reliably as Alpaca adds new event types, asset classes, international markets, and partner institutions.

Over time, you will have the opportunity to grow into broader ownership across clearing and post-trade infrastructure: security master, ledger integrity, multi-market readiness, and the platform foundations that keep brokerage, custody, and books and records in sync.

Things You Get To Do

  • Own Corporate Actions End-to-End: Drive the product roadmap for announcement capture, entitlement calculation, mandatory and voluntary event processing, payouts, and exception handling. Define timelines, acceptance criteria, and quality gates that ensure accurate, timely processing at scale.
  • Vendor & Data Quality: Own relationships with corporate action data providers. Build announcement review workflows and establish trustworthy announcement data as a prerequisite for automation.
  • Automate Safely: Design staged automation for mandatory corporate actions and pre-reconciliation.
  • Operations & Observability: Deliver entitlement worksheets, partial processing (process selected accounts or correspondents while excluding problematic ones), and dashboards for processing time, load, progress, and credited amounts..
  • Global & Partner Readiness: DCoordinate the corporate-action work required for newly launched international markets.
  • Upstream Data Governance: Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to prevent conflicts across Security Master, brokerage, and ledger systems.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • Corporate Actions Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of brokerage corporate action processing — announcement sources, record/ex/pay dates, entitlements, mandatory vs. voluntary events. You have lived through high-volume event seasons at a broker-dealer, clearing firm, or custody/post-trade platform.
  • Product Management Experience: Proven track record in Product Management or technical program management at a fintech, brokerage, or financial infrastructure company. You know how to create a roadmap, manage a backlog, and ship under hard operational deadlines.
  • Clearing / Post-Trade Fluency: Enough clearing depth to reason about stock record, ledgers, settlements, and books and records.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Exceptional ability to coordinate across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and Legal. You can translate complex business needs into clear engineering requirements and defend prioritization decisions.
  • Technical Fluency: Comfortable working with data systems, vendor feeds, reconciliation workflows, and partnering closely with engineers on observability and data integrity.
  • Operating Judgment: Strong judgment to weigh risk, operational efficiency, tech feasibility, time, and budget in a regulated self-clearing environment.

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves)

  • Familiarity with how corporate actions feed tax reporting (cost basis, wash sales, 1099 event mapping) and Security Master tax attributes.
  • Experience with B2B2C correspondent / broker-as-a-service models and partner sandbox/testing needs.
  • AI-native PM workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents in PRD drafting, incident synthesis, data exploration, and prototyping.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Recruitment Privacy Policy

jobs.title: Digital Product Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.jd_full:
About the Job

As a key growth accelerator, A11 partners with Europe’s most ambitious startups and scaleups, corporates and SMBs to connect them with top-tier talent ready to make an impact.

We’re looking for a Digital Product Manager (m/f/d) to help build out one of Europe’s most ambitious digital product organizations. Our partner company is a leading B2B mobility and payment solutions provider, serving customers in more than 50 countries. Built on over 90 years of continuous growth and innovation, the company has evolved into a market-leading platform with around 2,700 employees, processing €19 billion in transaction Volume. As the business enters its next phase of development, it is investing heavily in data, AI, and technology-enabled commercial excellence to strengthen its market position.

The business recently shifted from a Product Owner model to genuine, outcome-driven Product Management, and its core digital products just moved onto new infrastructure, opening up real room to shape how the organization builds going forward.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for discovering, building and improving digital products that solve meaningful customer problems and create measurable business value. Depending on whic product  you land, your product area could mean the tools that keep fleets compliant and moving, the platform capabilities other product teams build on, or the systems behind how transactions and services actually get delivered to customers. Either way, you’ll own it end to end. Working in an empowered, cross-functional Product Trio with Engineering and Design, you’ll contribute to product strategy, validate solutions through continuous discovery, and be measured on outcomes rather than outputs, delivering better customer experiences and sustainable business growth.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Discover customer and business opportunities through customer research, product analytics, market insight and continuous discovery
  • Lead product discovery and decision-making within your area, balancing customer needs, business goals and technical constraints
  • Define success metrics, hypotheses and experiments, using evidence and data to validate assumptions before you build
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design in a genuine, empowered Product Trio, not a hand-off model
  • Collaborate across Product, Sales, Customer Service and Marketing to drive adoption, commercialization and product success
  • Contribute to product strategy beyond your own area, and help shape how Product, Engineering and Design work together as the model matures
  • Identify risks early and build stakeholder alignment, taking ownership for outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to build

Your Profile:

  • 3+ years of Product Management experience in a SaaS or digital platform business environment
  • Proven ability to translate customer needs into measurable business outcomes, not just ship features
  • Solid experience in continuous discovery, experimentation, product analytics and data-informed decision-making
  • Real experience working in a cross-functional Product Trio with Engineering and Design, not just alongside them
  • Strong problem-solving skills, commercial awareness and an outcome-oriented mindset
  • Comfortable operating in an organization that is still actively defining its own ways of working, rather than one with a fully settled playbook
  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus

Benefits and Perks:

  • Real ownership of your own product area from day one, in a genuine Product Trio setup
  • Join a digital product organization that just made the shift from Product Owners to Product Managers, with real investment in coaching and growth
  • A clear path to grow into a more senior Product Manager role as you build your track record
  • Hybrid working model on a modern, Azure-based tech stack
  • A financially strong, owner-led business investing heavily in its digital future

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

A11 is committed to diverse and equal opportunities hiring for all – applicants, candidates, and employees alike. We value humans – with all our glorious multifaceted backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences – and look forward to your application.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
What we do. Electric Car Leasing

Why we do it. Greener. Fairer. Future.

We are looking for a super collaborative Product Manager to join our London team, to help grow one of Octopus Energy Group’s most exciting businesses and accelerate the driving public on their energy transition.

We are building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric revolution.

Not only can they learn about and shop for their EV online, but also experience a ‘lease for life’ through an industry-changing customer experience.

The Product team is crucial in defining and bringing to market this vision while working hand in hand with all teams across the company to deliver it in record time.

What you’ll do…

  • Define and deliver a prioritised roadmap of measurable outcomes

  • Run regular user research and interviews to understand jobs to be done

  • Test hypotheses through analytics, frequent shippable increments and iterative experiments

  • Use data to identify opportunities and track success

  • Demonstrate progress and direction of travel through storytelling and inclusive communication at every level of our business

  • Leverage modern tooling, including AI, to accelerate time to value

  • Collaborate company wide with high level of autonomy

What you’ll need…

  • Strong experience as a Product Manager owning software products end-to-end

  • Track record of delivery in fast-paced and cross-functional environments

  • Proficiency with shaping workflows and tooling for internal teams

  • Strong storytelling and relationship-building skills

  • Fluency with SQL and product analytics

  • Technical literacy and comfort collaborating with engineers

  • Demonstrable ability to thrive in high freedom, high agency culture

  • Interest in sustainability, green energy and zero-emissions transport.

Any of the following would be a bonus

  • Technical skills. We don’t need you to be a Product Engineer, but any Python experience or experience working with technical teams would be an advantage

  • Running AB Tests

Why you’ll love it here

  • Don’t feel like you meet all of our hiring criteria? Thats OK, apply anyway! We’d love to hear from you and have a conversation.

  • Octopus Electric Vehicles, part of the Octopus Energy Group, won the Sunday Times best company to work for in 2024. We were named 6th out of the top 100 start-ups to work for by Tempo in 2025 and on Glassdoor we were voted 50 best places to work in 2022. Our Group CEO, Greg has recorded a podcast about our culture and how we empower our people

  • Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! On a call with one of our recruiters it’s something we always cover as we genuinely want to match your experience with the correct salary. The reason why we don’t advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn’t apply to Octopus - what’s more important to us is finding the right octofit!

  • Octopus Energy Group is a unique culture. An organisation where people learn, decide, and build quicker. Where people work with autonomy, alongside a wide range of amazing co-owners, on projects that break new ground. We want your hard work to be rewarded with perks you actually care about! Visit our perks hub - Octopus Employee Benefits

Things to Note…

  • 🐶 just to let you know, we are dog friendly company so you may see our 4 legged friends in the offices - feel free to bring yours! Rest assured though, we’ve taken lots of precautions for those who have allergies
  • 🤖 We use AI to help us assess applications fairly and objectively. We’re totally fine with you using AI as a tool to help prepare too. That said, when we get to the interview and assessment stage, we’re really interested in hearing your unique perspective and real-world stories. That’s the stuff we can’t get from a bot or a prompt!

About us

The electric revolution has arrived - and from 2035 you’ll no longer be able to buy a new petrol or diesel car in the UK.

We’re building a whole new way for drivers to join the electric charge and not only learn about and shop for their EV online, but experience a ‘lease for life’ through an industry changing customer experience. This is the chance to join one of the UK’s most exciting start-ups – making it easy for individuals and businesses to go electric by getting their car, charger and energy all in one cracking deal.

Octopus Electric Vehicles launched in 2018 to make it seamless to switch to cleaner, greener driving. Our mission is to drive sustainable change, decarbonise the planet and provide our customers with fair pricing and a fantastic experience.

We’re an Octopus Energy company—an innovative new energy supplier. We are part of the Octopus Energy Group, which seeks to improve the lives of millions of people by transforming the industries we operate in. The Octopus Group incorporates Octopus Energy, Octopus Healthcare, Octopus Investments, Octopus Property, Octopus Ventures and Octopus Labs.

If this sounds like you then we’d love to hear from you.

Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have all the tools and environment you need to unleash your potential. Need any specific accommodations? Whether you require specific accommodations or have a unique preference, let us know, and we’ll do what we can to customise your interview process for comfort and maximum magic!

Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we hire. Across Octopus, we’re looking for genuinely decent people who are honest and empathetic. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities, an inclusive work environment, and fairness for everyone.

Where necessary, we sometimes use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, like reviewing applications or assessing responses.

We’re lucky to receive a huge amount of interest, so these tools help our recruiters manage that volume, not replace them. Ultimately, every hiring decision (for example, whether to progress your application or not) is always made by a real person in our Talent team.

If you’d like to know more about how we use your data, you can reach out to us via email at [email protected]. We’re happy to help!

jobs.title: Junior Technical Project Manager – Strategy & Operations
jobs.jd_full:
Descripción de la empresa

Founded in 2012, AUTO1 Group is Europe’s leading car trading platform, revolutionizing the way cars are bought and sold. By seamlessly connecting buyers and sellers through cutting-edge technology, we empower dealers and consumers across Europe. Our well-known brands include:

  • compramostucoche.es: A fast, convenient car sales service for consumers, with over 400 branches in 11 countries.

  • AUTO1.com: The go-to multi-brand platform for the used car trade, connecting 60,000+ professional partners with a portfolio of 30,000+ vehicles across 30+ countries.

  • Autohero: An innovative online retail platform offering high-quality, inspected used cars at the best prices, with a fully digital purchasing experience for private customers.

With over 13 years of success in Europe and a team of 8,000+ talented professionals, we’re driving the digital revolution in the automotive industry. Join us and be part of our exciting journey!

What We Offer:

  • Permanent contract.
  • Working hours: Monday to Friday, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
  • Hybrid working model: Remote work on Fridays.
  • 22 days of paid annual leave, plus an extra day off for your birthday.
  • Professional growth and development opportunities within a leading international company.
  • Dynamic and international working environment, with the opportunity to collaborate with teams across Europe.
  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects and make a real impact on business processes and operations.

Descripción del empleo

As a Junior Software Developer – Strategy & Operations, you will play a key role in developing digital tools, automating processes, and improving operational efficiency across AUTO1 Group’s European markets.

Combining your programming skills, analytical mindset, and business understanding, you will work closely with international teams to develop practical solutions that support and optimize our daily operations.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Develop Innovative Solutions: Design and develop internal tools, applications, and prototypes to optimize business processes and improve operational efficiency across European markets.
  • Drive Process Automation: Identify opportunities to automate workflows, streamline operations, and implement scalable solutions that enhance business performance.
  • Lead Technical Projects: Coordinate the development, testing, and continuous improvement of internal tools, working closely with technology teams in Germany.
  • Coordinate International Initiatives: Collaborate with different European markets and cross-functional teams to identify business needs, gather feedback, and translate requirements into practical solutions.
  • Support Implementation and Improvement: Ensure the successful rollout of new tools and processes, providing training, documentation, and ongoing support to local teams.

This is an exciting opportunity to combine software development, process automation, and international business operations, making a direct impact on AUTO1 Group’s digital transformation across Europe.

Requisitos

We’re seeking bright, ambitious minds with a passion for strategy, problem-solving, and innovation.

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2-4 years of experience in strategic business development, consulting, or start-ups, with a proven track record of driving results.
  • A background in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical fields.
  • Programming skills in TypeScript, Python, or Google Apps Script, with knowledge of frontend and backend development.
  • Familiarity with tools and technologies such as GitHub, Docker, Google Sheets, Visual Studio, AWS, or Jenkins.
  • Experience in process optimization, automation, or development of internal tools is a plus.
  • Fluency in Spanish and English (additional languages are a plus).

If you’re a proactive, results-driven professional who loves tackling challenges and working in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you!

Información adicional

Join a team driving the digital transformation of the automotive industry! Apply now to learn more about this opportunity.

Contact

Nuria Madrazo

Apply quickly and easily via WhatsApp and help us shape the future of buying and selling cars!
